# UK Startup Flow

> Expert guidance for starting, growing and scaling a business in the UK — plus practical guides on Companies House, HMRC, passports, MOT and benefits.

UK Startup Flow publishes clear, structured guides for UK founders, directors and self-employed people. Content is organised for both people and AI assistants: direct answers first, then steps, tables and FAQs.
